description.fallback: While Boruto is interviewed in Konohagakure for his role in saving the village from Isshiki, Amado performs maintenance on Kawaki's restored arm, during which Katasuke explains why Sumire is assisting. As she talks about Boruto, Kawaki embarrasses her by asking if she likes the genin. Elsewhere, Sarada, Mitsuki, and Team 10 discuss the restrictions placed on Boruto and his team.
